ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels to 35% low-intensity (black/grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields in the upper distal quadrants of both lobes; large triangular low-intensity (black) region centered at the median notch and extending along the lower interior margins; scattered high-contrast black mottling throughout the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated interior vertex angle of 52 degrees; vertical depth of notch represents approximately 20% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge; peaks are more pronounced and jagged on the left lobe trailing edge compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral S-curve sweep characterized by initial convexity at the notch transition followed by gradual concavity leading to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of circular white/grey points (barnacle colonization) concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes; isolated circular scars visible in the darker central regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive series of parallel linear disruptions (rake marks) traversing the white pigmentation on both lobes; primary orientation is vertical/diagonal relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct reddish-brown organic mass/protrusion is visible on the extreme edge of the left distal tip; significant calcified barnacle clusters at lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Intricate, filigree-like grey pigmentation patterns localized in the upper-right white quadrant of the right lobe; dark spotted clustering along the lower left margin near the water line.
